name: Rkundzelft
summary: Rkundzelft is a Dwemer ruin in eastern Craglorn, just south of the Lake of Teeth, inhabited by dwarven automatons. It was originally build by the Rourken clan. Many dwarven urns, pots and jars are scattered throughout the delve. A Treasure Hunter's Journal can be found in the southern portion of the southeastern room. Within the central northern room (near the end of the delve) is a giant dwarven spider known as Mzeklok, which serves as the delve's boss. The skyshard is located on a pedestal on the eastern side of this same room. Past the boss room is a hallway. A chest can spawn in the northeast corner of the chamber to the north of that hallway. Sandroaches are found in numbers within.
